title: Call to `updatePoolRate` is missing
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Medium, because it happens only for a paused and then resumed pool  **Impact:** Medium, because it can hardly lead to big losses  ## Description  Every time the `totalStaked` amount of a pool is updated, the `updatePoolRate` method is called to update the `EarnRateSec`. This is not true for the `pauseReward` method, which calls `updatePool` that changes the `totalStaked` amount. Now if a pool is paused, when it gets resumed again and `updatePool` is called it will calculate less rewards than it should had, because `EarnRateSec` was not updated.  ## Recommendations
